task.description:
CODE-DESIGNER Step 2 (REWORK 1) - fix the lint failures in the design at src/design/integration-test-advisory-lock.md.

The previous design failed lint with 1 MAJOR and 6 MINOR findings:

1. [MAJOR] E050 at line 68 - fenced code block exceeds 40 lines. Either replace with prose, or split into multiple shorter blocks (each <= 40 lines).

2. [MINOR] E030 - schema-qualified names at lines 23, 360, 362, 401. Use unqualified names instead (e.g. tenant instead of public.tenant, tenant_schemas instead of public.tenant_schemas). The linter enforces this anti-pattern rule.

The design content (recommendation of option (a), 32-file inventory, patterns, errors, verification plan) is otherwise correct. Only these structural defects need to be fixed.

After edits:
- Run: python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/integration-test-advisory-lock.md - must exit 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR.
- DO NOT remove the existing 32-file inventory, recommendation, or verification plan.
acceptance_criteria: python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/integration-test-advisory-lock.md exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR
Design recommends one of the two options with justification
All affected files listed with the exact change required per file
Errors section enumerates failure modes if not followed
Verification plan is concrete (3+ clean runs after fix)
No schema-qualified table names in prose (only inside quoted SQL where required)

result.summary: Rework 1: fixed E050 (split oversized fenced code block at original line 68 into 2 blocks each <=40 lines via prose lead-in for the first function) and E030 (replaced 6 schema-qualified names with unqualified names in prose: line 23 tenant_schemas; lines 360/362 tenant; lines 401 tenant and tenant_schemas). Lint_design_artefact.py now exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR. Design content (option (a) recommendation, 32-file inventory, patterns A/B/global-helper, error taxonomy, verification plan) preserved unchanged.
